q: What are the emissions of running a mortuary cold room?
title: Mortuary cold room emissions
short: Refrigeration electricity runs around the clock: compressor kWh times 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh. Refrigerant leaks topped up during servicing are Scope 1, multiplied by the gas's warming potential, and they can rival the electricity.
audience: Hospitals, municipal mortuaries and funeral services

ul: Sub meter for the cold chamber, or compressor rating times hours.
Service records with refrigerant kg added.

p: Door seals, insulation and leak checks lower both lines at once.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
